contexts.text: (By his presence in Heaven) he took away their perception of good and truth, and thus their delight.
Lest (an evil Spirit) should have communication with any Society of Heaven, everything true and good is taken away from him.
That this power was taken away from them. Signified. To swallow = to take away.
Those in Hell, from whom have been taken away the truths they had known, cannot but speak falsities.
By the coming (of the angelic Spirits of Mars) the communication was taken away.
Lest they should apply the things of the light of Heaven to defend falsities and evils, everything of that kind is taken away.
That the communication (with the things of Heaven) might be taken away. Signified, Explained.
Externals are successively taken away from them...
Not to take away spiritual life from anyone. Signified, Explained.
That from them is taken away association with Spirits...
Lest he should do this, there is taken away from him the knowledge of truth...
